title: Genome Browser
description: Explore lncRNA and regulatory data in an interactive genome browser powered by IGV.js. Navigate through chromosomes, view gene annotations, and analyze regulatory regions.
searchError: Failed to navigate to the specified location
noConfigDesc: The genome browser configuration for this species is not available. Please try another species or contact support.
geneLoadModeDesc: Enter a lncRNA gene name to load its genomic location and associated regulatory relationships. Only data related to this gene will be displayed.
speciesBrowseModeDesc: Browse the complete genome of the selected species. Navigate freely to any chromosome location and view genome-wide data.
remoteGenomeNoteDesc: This genome is loaded from UCSC servers. Initial loading may take a moment depending on your network connection.

tracks.repeatMaskerDesc: Display repeat elements in the genome (LINE, SINE, LTR, etc.)
